commit 83e8d877741c300c81e5b933c32600803587bd84
Author:     Vineet Deo <vineet@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Jun 20 22:10:56 2024 +0000
Commit:     Vineet Deo <vineet@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Jun 20 22:10:56 2024 +0000

    Bug 1899765 - Add Help menu items for daily and beta. r=freaktechnik
    
    **How to Test**
    - Open the system help menu, you should see menu items for daily and beta
    - Open the app help menu, you should see menu items for daily and beta
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D212626

diff --git a/mail/base/content/helpMenu.inc.xhtml b/mail/base/content/helpMenu.inc.xhtml
index 65610bea16a..1754e13acfc 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/helpMenu.inc.xhtml
+++ b/mail/base/content/helpMenu.inc.xhtml
@@ -10,6 +10,11 @@
                     data-l10n-id="menu-help-get-help"
                     key="key_openHelp"
                     oncommand="openSupportURL();"/>
+#if MOZ_UPDATE_CHANNEL == beta || defined(NIGHTLY_BUILD)
+          <menuitem id="menu_openReleaseHelp"
+                    data-l10n-id="menu-help-get-release-help"
+                    oncommand="openLinkText(event, 'releaseSupportURL');" />
+#endif
           <menuitem id="menu_keyboardShortcuts"
                     data-l10n-id="menu-help-shortcuts"
                     oncommand="openLinkText(event, 'keyboardShortcutsURL');"/>
diff --git a/mail/base/content/utilityOverlay.js b/mail/base/content/utilityOverlay.js
index abfc27c5fe4..d3fe5838406 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/utilityOverlay.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/utilityOverlay.js
@@ -186,6 +186,14 @@ function openLinkText(event, what) {
     case "feedbackURL":
       openUILink("https://connect.mozilla.org/", event);
       break;
+    case "releaseSupportURL":
+      if (AppConstants.NIGHTLY_BUILD) {
+        openUILink("https://support.mozilla.org/kb/thunderbird-daily", event);
+        break;
+      }
+
+      openUILink("https://support.mozilla.org/kb/thunderbird-beta", event);
+      break;
   }
 }
 
diff --git a/mail/components/customizableui/content/panelUI.inc.xhtml b/mail/components/customizableui/content/panelUI.inc.xhtml
index e6602ad461e..5d1ab4640ce 100644
--- a/mail/components/customizableui/content/panelUI.inc.xhtml
+++ b/mail/components/customizableui/content/panelUI.inc.xhtml
@@ -561,6 +561,12 @@
                        data-l10n-id="appmenu-help-get-help"
                        key="key_openHelp"
                        oncommand="openSupportURL();"/>
+#if MOZ_UPDATE_CHANNEL == beta || defined(NIGHTLY_BUILD)
+        <toolbarbutton id="appmenu_openReleaseHelp"
+                       class="subviewbutton subviewbutton-iconic"
+                       data-l10n-id="appmenu-help-get-release-help"
+                       oncommand="openLinkText(event, 'releaseSupportURL');" />
+#endif
         <toolbarbutton id="appmenu_keyboardShortcuts"
                        class="subviewbutton subviewbutton-iconic"
                        data-l10n-id="appmenu-help-shortcuts"
diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/appmenu.ftl b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/appmenu.ftl
index ec26206e9ef..12208cc9156 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/appmenu.ftl
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/appmenu.ftl
@@ -209,6 +209,10 @@ appmenu-help-get-help =
   .label = Get Help
   .accesskey = H
 
+appmenu-help-get-release-help =
+    .label = Get Help with { -brand-short-name }
+    .accesskey = R
+
 appmenu-help-shortcuts =
   .label = Keyboard Shortcuts
   .accesskey = K
diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/menubar.ftl b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/menubar.ftl
index 8c067eb2e70..95f8bbb01c0 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/menubar.ftl
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/menubar.ftl
@@ -26,6 +26,10 @@ menu-help-get-help =
     .label = Get Help
     .accesskey = H
 
+menu-help-get-release-help =
+    .label = Get Help with { -brand-short-name }
+    .accesskey = R
+
 menu-help-shortcuts =
     .label = Keyboard Shortcuts
     .accesskey = K
diff --git a/mail/themes/shared/mail/panelUI.css b/mail/themes/shared/mail/panelUI.css
index 487e5d6d505..6f4aeec96df 100644
--- a/mail/themes/shared/mail/panelUI.css
+++ b/mail/themes/shared/mail/panelUI.css
@@ -1125,7 +1125,8 @@ menulist {
 /* Help */
 
 #appmenu_help,
-#appmenu_openHelp {
+#appmenu_openHelp,
+#appmenu_openReleaseHelp {
   list-style-image: var(--icon-question);
 }
